updates.t: AP’s count as of Nov 16, 12:15pm CET shows 256 House seats won by Democrats and 169 by Republicans. 10 House seats are counted as won for no party in those results, which do not say why or which way they will go. In the Senate, AP’s count as of Nov 16, 12:14pm CET shows a total of 55 seats for Democrats and 44 for Republicans. 1 Senate seat is counted as won or held over for neither party in those results, which also do not say why or which way it will go. These numbers may have changed since then.

In Alaska’s US Senate race, AP’s count as of Nov 17, 3:52am CET shows Democrat Mary Peltola with 141,637 votes (50.0%) and Republican Dan S. Sullivan with 130,162 votes (45.9%), with an estimated 98% of votes counted. AP has not called this race, and the count is not finished. These numbers may have changed since then.
